description: Wire outputs, update docs, generate CI/CD templates

questions.question: Are all cross-module outputs correctly wired in the root main.tf?
questions.notes: Service modules export outputs that the root module re-exports or uses

questions.question: Is the state backend configuration (terraform backend.tf) correct?
questions.notes: Remote state must point to the right S3 bucket and DynamoDB lock table

questions.question: Are CI/CD pipeline templates generated (GitHub Actions / GitLab CI)?
questions.notes: Templates for plan, apply, drift detection, and rollback

questions.question: Is the README updated with architecture overview and instructions?
questions.notes: How to init, plan, apply, and manage the infrastructure

questions.question: Are Makefile targets created for common operations?
questions.notes: make plan, make apply, make validate, etc.

questions.question: Are pre-commit hooks configured for Terraform?
questions.notes: Automatic fmt, validate, and security checks before commits

questions.question: Is the terraform.tfvars example file filled with sensible defaults?
questions.notes: Dev environment should have minimal but functional defaults
